name: Data.Pair.lValueProd_eq
summary: Unfold lValueProd over the union of disjoint sets of places, and write each |L|² for (νϑ^s)⁻¹ as the ratio squared times |L|² for ν⁻¹.

steps.claim: Unfold lValueProd on both sides; the product of norms over the union {chosen} ∪ Q splits (`finprod_mem_union`, the sets being disjoint).
steps.lean: by rw [lValueProd, lValueProd, finprod_mem_union, finprod_mem_coe_finset, Nat.mul_comm]

steps.claim: Distribute the powers and products; compare factor by factor.
For each z′, the ratio of the lowered pair is non-zero and real (`Data.Pair.ratio_ne_zero_and_real`).
Each factor: |L(z′, (νϑ^s)⁻¹)|² = ratio² ·|L(z′, ν⁻¹)|² (definition of ratio, the clamped point being z′), with the disjointness of the chosen places and Q (`levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q`).
steps.lean:
repeat simp_all [ratio, lowerPoint, field, Set.disjoint_right, IsChosen,
       levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q _ ϑ, ↓finite_isChosen]
